messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The brands of bupropion are FDA-approved for specific conditions.
Wellbutrin SR is used to treat major depressive disorder.
Wellbutrin XL is used to treat MDD and seasonal affective disorder (SAD).
Aplenzin is used to treat MDD and SAD.
Zyban (discontinued) was used to help stop smoking.
Auvelity (bupropion with dextromethorphan) is used to treat MDD in adults.
Contrave (bupropion and naltrexone) is used for weight management for specific patients.
The information on this page is only about bupropion.
It is not about bupropion with dextromethorphan (Auvelity).
It is not about bupropion with naltrexone (Contrave).
Triplet: ["Zyban", "used for", "help stop smoking"]

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used for the purpose specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
F. None of the above.
